summary: Added JSON repair fallbacks for malformed agent output in scout and lessons parse paths. In src/goal/scout.ts, validateScoutOutput now retries scout_report.json parsing with repairJsonText before returning validation error. In src/goal/lessons.ts, parseJsonLines now retries each failed JSONL line with repairJsonText before skipping. Added regression tests in src/goal/scout.test.ts (trailing extra brace in scout_report.json) and src/goal/lessons.test.ts (malformed JSONL line with trailing brace during lesson extraction). Verification passed: pnpm vitest run src/goal/, pnpm lint, pnpm build.
